> Independent, source-cited pet care editorial resource. Evidence-based guides on dog nutrition and food safety (a can-dogs-eat series with weight-based dose tables and symptom timelines), puppy behaviour and training, dog health, and cat care. Every guide cites veterinary sources such as the ASPCA, the Merck Veterinary Manual and Cornell University, and carries a last-checked date. No fabricated author personas: an organizational editorial team with a published methodology.

Free to read, no signup, no affiliate links. Not affiliated with any veterinary organization.

## Topic hubs

- [Dog Nutrition](https://wagwise.org/dog-nutrition/): food safety series and feeding guides
- [Dog Health](https://wagwise.org/dog-health/): symptoms, causes, when to see a vet
- [Dog Training](https://wagwise.org/dog-training/): puppy biting, crate training, leash training
- [Dog Care](https://wagwise.org/dog-care/): nails, teeth, grooming routines
- [Cat Care](https://wagwise.org/cat/): behaviour and health guides

## Most-referenced food safety guides

- [Can Dogs Eat Grapes](https://wagwise.org/dog-nutrition/can-dogs-eat-grapes/): why there is no safe dose, symptom timeline, emergency steps
- [Can Dogs Eat Chocolate](https://wagwise.org/dog-nutrition/can-dogs-eat-chocolate/): risk by cocoa type and body weight
- [Can Dogs Eat Xylitol](https://wagwise.org/dog-nutrition/can-dogs-eat-xylitol/): thresholds by body weight
- [Foods Toxic to Dogs](https://wagwise.org/dog-nutrition/foods-toxic-to-dogs/): overview of the dangerous-food list

## Tools

- [Dog Age Calculator](https://wagwise.org/tools/dog-age-calculator/): age conversion by size class

- [Editorial Standards](https://wagwise.org/about/editorial-standards/): sourcing rules, update policy, checked dates
